title: [Skin Concerns] New Skin Care Routine Pt2
text:
Hi again!

I need help with a new skin care routine. I am looking for moisturizer, sunscreen, and cleanser.

**Skin type**: Dry, occasional pimples, but not many.

**Current Routine:** Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser for cleaning (night) and a scrub (BioMiracle Slim Facial Scrub with Brown Sugar & Coffee) once a week.

**How long:** I've been using the cleanser for over a year, and the scrub for years. I recently dropped my moisturizer cuz it was causing breakouts (some angry red pimples)

**My location:** Chihuahuan desert (pretty dry)

**History:** I have allergic reactions to honey when it is in skin care products. When a product doesn't work for me, my skin isn't shy to break out and let me know. 

**Cerave Daily Moisturizing Lotion for Normal to Dry skin** gave me pimples. I tried it for over a month.

**Super Greens Nourishing Cleanser Nettoyant** led to breaking out into pimples. I think I used it for two months.

**La Roche Posay for Normal to Dry Skin Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Cleanser** didn't feel like it was cleaning my skin. I used it for a month.

**Banana Boat Sun Comfort Sunscreen Lotion UVA/UVB Broad Spectrum SPF 50+** causes pimple breakouts when I use it on my face.  


**Weleda Skin Food Light Nourishing Cream** caused angry red pimples. I used it for over a month.

**Shiseido Essential Energy Moisturizing Cream** breakouts after over a month. 

I used Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce and the Banana Souffle moisturizer for more than a year. The moisturizer started to make my skin feel hot and itchy. The cleanser doesn't feel like it does much.   

Please help me find a cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen to protect and respect my skin.

Thank you
